verses.text: Ha winhaj Joás chi', uke' ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal. 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Sibia sb'i ix snun winh, aj Beerseba ix.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Joás chi', yakb'an pitzanto winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi', te wach'nhej t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha winhaj Joiada chi' ix sayan chawanh heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj Joás chi', ay yalyuninal winh yet' heb' ix.
Ix ek' jab'ok tiempo, ix sna'an winhaj rey Joás chi' to sb'ochajxi stemplo Jehová.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej heb' winh sacerdote winh yet' heb' winh levita, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ixikek t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá tik, sb'at he molb'an k'e'en tumin, haton k'e'en syak'taxon heb' ketchonhab' tik t'a junjun ab'il yik sb'ochajxi stemplo Dios tik. Hak'ek wal eyip he b'ati, xchi winh. Palta maj yak'och wal heb' winh t'a sk'o'ol sb'ati.

Yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj sat sacerdote Joiada yuj winhaj rey Joás chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj max ak'och t'a a k'ol iptzitan heb' winh levita yik sb'at yik'kot k'e'en ofrenda heb' winh t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik, icha yalnakkan winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová to masanil heb' ketisraelal smolan k'e'en tumin yik sb'ochaj skajnub' skaxail strato Jehová? xchi winh rey chi'.

Yujto a ix Atalía yet' heb' ochnak tzak'an yuj ix, ix ixtanb'at stemplo Jehová chi'. Ha juntzanh yamk'ab' niwak yelk'och yik templo chi', a ix sk'an heb' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a jun komon Dios Baal.
Yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey Joás chi' b'ochaj jun te' kaxa, haxo t'a stielta stemplo Jehová ix schek winh ak'chajkan te'.
Ix schekan winh alchajel t'a masanil yol yik Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén chi' to tz'ik'chajkot k'e'en ofrenda alb'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová t'a tzinan lu'um.
Masanil heb' winh yajal yaji yet' masanil anima, t'a wal smasanil sk'ol heb' ix yak'em yofrenda t'a yol jun kaxa chi', masanto ix b'ut'ji te' yuj heb'.

Haxo heb' winh levita tz'ik'anb'at te' kaxa chi' t'a winh rey chi', haxo yik syilan winh to b'ut'anxo te', tz'awtaj winh stz'ib'um winh yet' jun winh ayoch yopisio yuj winh sat sacerdote. Sekanelta k'e'en tumin chi' heb' winh t'a yol te' kaxa chi', sb'at yak'anxikan te' heb' winh b'aj aykan chi'. Icha chi' syutej heb' winh t'a junjun k'u, yuj chi' niwan k'e'en tumin chi' ix molchaji.

Ha winh rey chi' yet' winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi' ix yak' k'e'en tumin chi' heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yilan munlajel sb'o t'a stemplo Jehová chi', yik saychaj heb' winh mak'umpoj k'e'en, heb' winh nhikum te', heb' winh smunlaj t'a k'e'en hierro yet' t'a k'e'en bronce, yik wach' sb'ochajxi templo chi'.
Yuj chi' a heb' winh tz'ilan munlajel chi', a heb' winh skuchb'an heb' winh swach' b'oanxi templo chi'. Ix sb'o heb' winh icha wal yajtaxon t'a yichb'anel, te wach' ix ajxikan sb'o yuj heb' winh.

Haxo yik ix lajwi sb'oel yuj heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at k'e'en tumin heb' winh ixto kani, ix yak'an k'e'en heb' winh t'a winh rey yet' t'a winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi'. Haxo yet' k'e'en ix schek winh rey chi' b'ochaj yamk'ab' yik templo chi', haton juntzanh sk'anchaji ayik tz'och ejmelal yet' juntzanh sk'anchaj t'a altar yuj silab' snhusjitz'aok, icha k'e'en niwak cuchara yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a oro, ma plata. Yakb'an pitzanto winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi', snhusjitz'anhej silab' t'a stemplo Jehová.
Palta ix ichamwinakax winhaj Joiada chi', 130 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.

Ha t'a schonhab' winhaj David ix mukji winh, haton b'aj smukchaj heb' winh rey. Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh te wach'nhej yuj swach'ilok heb' yetisraelal, wach' ix yutej winh yak'an serwil Dios yet' t'a stemplo.

Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Joiada chi', ix jawi heb' winh yajal yaj t'a Judá, ix em nhojan heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Joás chi' yik smontan winh heb' winh. Haxo ix aji, ix och t'a spensar winh tas ix yal heb' winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yaktejkan stemplo Jehová heb', haton sDiosal smam yicham heb'. Haxo t'a yechel komon Dios Asera ix och heb' ejmelal yet' t'a juntzanhxo komon Dios. Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a heb' aj Judá chi' yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén chi'.
Ix schekkot heb' schekab' Jehová yik tzul yalan heb' to smeltzajxi heb' t'a Jehová chi', palta majxo schalaj yab' heb' tas ix yal heb' chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi', ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Zacarías yuninalkan winhaj Joiada chi'. Ix k'e linhan winh t'a jun lugar cha'anh, ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová Dios tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tas yuj max he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il? ¿Tas yuj tze saykot eyaelal t'a eyib'anh? Yujto ix in eyaktajkani, yuj chi' ol ex waktejpaxkani, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Palta ix och heb' ajk'olal smasanil t'a winh, ix sna'an heb' tas tz'aj smilancham winh heb'. Ix yalan winhaj rey Joás chi' to sjulk'enajcham winh t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová. Icha chi' ix aj scham winh.

Ha winhaj Joás chi', majxo snakotlaj jantak swach'k'olal winhaj Joiada chi' ix yak' t'a winh, palta to ix schek miljokcham winhaj Zacarías winh, haton winh yuninal winhaj Joiada chi'. Ayik wan scham winhaj Zacarías chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Aokab' Jehová tz'ilan jun tik, ha' ol ak'an yowalil, xchi winh.

Ayik ix el yab'ilal scham winh, ix jawi heb' soldado sirio yak' owal yet' winhaj Joás chi'. Ix jawi heb' t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén. Tzijtum heb' yajal yaj t'a Judá chi' ix smilcham heb'. Ix yik'anek' masanil tas ay stojol heb', ix yak'anb'at heb' t'a winh sreyal Damasco.

Jaywannhej heb' soldado sirio ix jawi yak' owal chi', haxo Jehová ix ak'anoch jantak heb' soldado yik Judá chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', yujto ix aktajkan Jehová chi' yuj heb', haton sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham. Icha wal chi' ix aj yab'an sya'il winhaj Joás chi' yuj chukal ix sk'ulej.

Ayik ix el heb' sirio t'a yol yik Judá chi', te niwan ix ajkan winhaj Joás chi' slajwi yuj heb'. Haxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh, ix sna' heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh swach' milancham winh, yik syak'anek' spak schamel winh yuninal winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi' heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix swach' milejcham winh heb' winh t'a sat sch'at. Ixlajwi chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David, palta manhok b'aj smukchaj heb' winh rey.
Ha heb' winh ix wach' milancham winhaj Joás chi', haton winhaj Zadad yune' ix Simat aj Amón yet' winhaj Jozabad yune' ix Simrit aj Moab.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás chi' yet' heb' yuninal winh yet' lolonel ix yal heb' schekab' Dios t'a winh yet' yab'ixal b'aj swach' b'oejxi stemplo Jehová winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh rey. Haxo winhaj Amasías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
